automated.summary: governed-joins STORY CLOSEOUT — Financial semantic layer + governed joins, all 4 tasks shipped and merged. (1) gl-month-rollups (PR #20): two read-only warehouse views reduce each ingested object to ONE active row per (gl_code, month) BEFORE any join — actual_by_gl_month sums DUB actuals across cost centres (constant plant='DUB' column, active-batch filter inherited via actual_by_key_month) and budget_by_gl_month rolls the active budget batch up with a deterministic array_agg(DISTINCT cost_center ORDER BY cost_center) Budget-Components label set plus raw rollover carried. (2) composed-relation (PR #21): a builder-only DomainSpec.composed marker makes sqlBuilder emit WITH actual_src/budget_src CTEs FULL OUTER JOINed on (gl_code, month) with COALESCE zero-fill cast to numeric(18,2), replacing the multi-gold-object throw; row scope is applied to BOTH sources (Actual by plant IN (validated scope), Budget by the derived-constant guard 'DUB' IN (scope)); a governed-financial 'report' action is enforced fail-closed at the shared executeResolved boundary together with the domain and every selected measure/dimension grant. (3) governed-domain-measures (PR #22): a code-authored governed-financial DomainSpec with Actual (SUM(actual_net)), Budget (SUM(budget_net)) and a % measure whose verbatim SQL CASE realises the FULL nil rule in one text column (NULL/NA for 0/0, 'over-budget' for +Actual/Budget=0, 'credit / negative actual' for -Actual/Budget=0, else the ratio), timeColumn 'month' so period windows bind, plus the domain/measure/dimension grant seeds. (4) golden-provenance (PR #23): a frozen golden fixture + strict by-field loader assert EXACT values across all six decision-0016 cases (matched / Budget-only zero-fill / Actual-only zero-fill / duplicate-multi-cost-centre no-fan-out / reload-active-swap proving a budget reload CHANGES the answer with actuals untouched and the new batch id in-query / %-edges), and the composed query captures provenance in-query — row-aligned source-presence, the deterministic Budget-Components label set, and the active source batch ids as (source, period, batchId) tuples with each batch gated on its own FULL-OUTER-JOIN side so one-sided rows cite only their contributing batch — surfaced on the extended Provenance type via SelectionExecutor and chat.service. Net capability: ONE governed financial definition (Actual / Budget / %) over a correct, zero-filled, non-fan-out Budget⋈Actual join that report, drill-down and the assistant all share, with every number attributable to its active source batches.
